Ethan V.: Heads-up: EOD invoice run shows a handful of invoices with wildly wrong totals + one customer got two invoices with the same id.
Lina Q.: Which customer / example ids?
Ethan V.: Samples: 2026-03-26-RD-4201 (total $0.00 but line items present), 2026-03-26-RD-4202 (duplicate invoice id sent twice to customer@example.com).
Billing Bot: invoice-service ERROR: invoice_finalize_failed invoice_id=2026-03-26-RD-4202 reason=duplicate_sequence_detected s3_put_status=409
Sam P.: We also have a pattern where some numeric line amounts ended up blank in PDFs. Could be a formatting/locale issue where commas vs dots got parsed.
Renee H.: Interesting. We shipped a helper lib for CSV export yesterday that had a change to NumberFormat for EU locales. That could affect downstream pdf-gen which reads the reconciled CSV.
Ethan V.: In the raw reconciler output I see lines like: 
```
customer_id,sku,qty,unit_price,total
redwood-555,token_usage,10000,"0,0035","0,35"
```
(note commas as decimal separator)
Lina Q.: If pdf-gen or invoice finalizer expects dot decimals, it could parse "0,35" as string -> 0 or null, producing $0 total or blank amount. That explains the $0.00 invoices.
Sam P.: How did duplicate invoice id happen? Are there two reconciliation runs writing the same invoice_id?
Billing Bot: reconcile WARNING: reconciliation_retry job=rec-991 partition=pt-19 duplicate_output_detected invoice_id=2026-03-26-RD-4202
Renee H.: The CSV exporter used by reconciler wrote locale-specific numbers when the system locale was overridden during the deploy window (we set LC_NUMERIC=fr_FR for a monitoring test and forgot to reset). That changed number serialization for ~15 minutes.
Ethan V.: Ok root cause seems to be: LC_NUMERIC override -> CSV with comma decimals -> pdf-gen/parser misreads amounts -> some invoices zeroed; plus reconciler retry created duplicate outputs for at least one partition causing same invoice_id to be enqueued twice to pdf-queue.
Lina Q.: Immediate actions: 1) Pause outbound emails 2) Pause auto_finalization 3) Find all invoices generated between 2026-03-26T14:10:00Z and 2026-03-26T14:30:00Z and mark for reprocess.
Ethan V.: Billing Bot, please set outbound_email_paused=true and auto_finalize=false for 90m.
Billing Bot: command accepted: outbound_email_paused=true auto_finalize=false (expires in 90m) :white_check_mark:
Sam P.: SQL to find affected invoices: 
```
SELECT invoice_id FROM invoice_line_items
WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-26T14:10:00Z' AND '2026-03-26T14:30:00Z'
AND (line_amount IS NULL OR line_amount = 0)
```
Renee H.: I'll revert the LC_NUMERIC change and deploy a small sanity check in the CSV exporter to force dot decimal formatting regardless of env locale (PR incoming). ETA 20m.
Lina Q.: I'll write a fixup job to reparse the impacted reconciler CSVs treating commas as decimal separators when needed and regenerate invoice_line_items, then dedupe duplicate reconciler outputs. Plan: run in dry mode first, then regenerate PDFs.
Ethan V.: For the duplicate invoice_id 2026-03-26-RD-4202, let's remove the stale S3 object and re-generate PDF from the canonical reconciler output. Anyone saw two different contents for the two PDFs?
Sam P.: I downloaded both from S3: they are identical content-wise but both were uploaded (timestamps 14:16:23 and 14:16:49). So duplicate write from reconciler retry.
Billing Bot: audit-log created ticket=INV-4438 tags=[locale-serialization,duplicate-invoice]
Renee H.: I'll push the CSV exporter patch and add an assert that numeric serialization uses dot, plus add a linter check to catch LC_* overrides in deploy jobs.
Lina Q.: Action items: 
- Renee: revert LC_NUMERIC and ship exporter patch (ETA 20m)
- Lina: run dry-run fixup and list affected invoice_ids (ETA 30m)
- Ethan: coordinate customer outreach for invoices already emailed (if any slipped through) and prepare credit/corrected invoice templates (ETA 45m)
- Sam: add a short-term alert on reconciler retries that produce duplicate outputs (PagerDuty)
Ethan V.: I'll keep this thread updated. If you find more invoice_ids paste them here. Thanks folks. :pray:
Lina Q.: One more: add a small unit test for parsing both "," and "." to the pdf-gen parser to be safe.
